children: New ERA Energy & Digital entered into an at-the-market issuance sales agreement to sell up to $100 million of common stock through multiple agents. The program allows opportunistic share sales on Nasdaq or other markets at the Company’s discretion, with agent commissions up to 3.5% of gross proceeds. Shares will be offered under an effective shelf registration, and net proceeds are intended for general corporate purposes, including capex, working capital, and potential debt repayment.
